items.headline: AI compute provider Nscale is looking for $3.5B in pre-IPO financing
items.detail: Nscale, which recently struck a $45 billion deal with Anthropic, is in talks to raise additional funds in anticipation of an upcoming IPO.

items.headline: Judge blocks X rival from using Twitter name, but allows ‘Tweet’ for now
items.detail: A federal judge temporarily barred an X rival from using the Twitter name, but found that X was likely to have abandoned the “Tweet” trademark and bird logo. The startup has since relaunched as Tweet.app.

items.headline: Audacity 4 is a complete revamp of the ‘world’s most popular’ audio editor
items.detail: Audacity 4 has been in the works for some time, and had its own mini controversy last year when an unfortunate redesigned logo started making the rounds.

items.headline: The White House is making arcade games racist
items.detail: The PR masterminds at the White House just released a series of vaguely policy-themed "arcade" games, some of which are racist - and modeled on real games whose copyright holders may not be too happy to be associated with the MAGA agenda.

items.headline: Tesla's stock drops 6% as Cybercab update 'underwhelms' Wall Street
items.detail: Tesla's long-awaited Cybercab update failed to dazzle investors.

items.headline: Back-to-school shopping brought to you by AI — how Amazon, Google are positioned to win
items.detail: The rise of AI-assisted shopping during this year's back-to-school season may be an early window into evolving consumer buying habits.
